# Phase 5 report (generated by `03-agent/harness/report.py`)

Time limit per run: O 15 min, O30 30 min, O30-ngram 30 min, O30-tool 30 min. Success = every test passes, the visible test files are byte-identical, finished inside the arm's limit.
Primary unit: the first run of each task (every arm has one); a second run, where it exists, is used only for the stability line.

| arm | tasks | success | rate (Wilson 95%) | median min (all runs) | median min (successes) | timeouts | tests passed (mean share) | median steps | median tool calls | median completion tokens | usable? |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| O | 12 | 7/12 | 58% (32-81%) | 7.6 | 2.9 | 7 | 75% | 11.0 | 12.0 | 3481.0 | no |
| O30 | 12 | 6/12 | 50% (25-75%) | 6.4 | 4.1 | 2 | 78% | 12.0 | 11.5 | 2793.0 | no |
| O30-ngram | 12 | 6/12 | 50% (25-75%) | 8.8 | 3.3 | 2 | 82% | 20.0 | 19.5 | 3789.5 | no |
| O30-tool | 12 | 9/12 | 75% (47-91%) | 6.2 | 4.8 | 2 | 90% | 10.5 | 11.0 | 2353.5 | **yes** |

Pooled over every run of the arm (second estimator; the runs of one task are not independent, so these intervals are optimistic): **O** 14/23 = 61% (41-78%); **O30** 6/12 = 50% (25-75%); **O30-ngram** 6/12 = 50% (25-75%); **O30-tool** 9/12 = 75% (47-91%).

Usable = success rate >= 60% **and** median time per task <= 15 min (docs/PROTOCOL.md). Times count a failed run at the time it ran (at most the limit).
